newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: TENNIS-KORDA PUTS CZECHS AHEAD AGAINST INDIA.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-KORDA PUTS CZECHS AHEAD AGAINST INDIA.

text.p: Czech number one Petr Korda overcame a spate of unforced errors to beat Mahesh Bhupathi 6-3 6-7 6-1 6-2 and give the Czech Republic a 1-0 lead over India in their Davis Cup world group first round tie on Friday.
The veteran Korda, ranked more than 450 places higher than his opponent, showed few signs of trouble early in the match cruising to the first set in 29 minutes.
But a number of unforced errors allowed Bhupathi to stay in the second set which the Indian player finally won 7-2 in a tie break.
Korda, ranked 33rd in the world, eventually shifted his game into high gear and ease the pressure on Jiri Novak, who was facing Leander Paes in Friday's second singles match.
